adapterWarnings: fixed-rank heightening text has no structurally-parseable damage bump (a non-damage effect, e.g. added targets/area) — kept as a description appendix only

description.value:
You reach into a creature's personal timeline and hurl it decades into the future, leaving its body wizened, aged, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Enfeebled]{Enfeebled} while its mind remains trapped in the present. The target must attempt a Fortitude saving throw.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature's apparent age advances rapidly and then snaps back over 1 round. It is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 1} until the start of your next turn.

Failure The creature is cursed with accelerated aging. It takes a –2 status penalty to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution-based rolls (attack rolls, skill checks, saving throws) and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet. This curse persists until removed.

Critical Failure As failure, but the penalty is –3 to all affected rolls and the Speed reduction is 20 feet. Additionally, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Enfeebled]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (8th) On a failure, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Drained]{Drained 2} (permanent until the curse is removed). On a critical failure, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Drained]{Drained 3} instead.
